description: The compliance review a robo-advisor or advisory agent should run before recommending a portfolio to a person: compares the proposal with the client's age, horizon, risk tolerance, liquidity needs and experience under Reg BI / fiduciary standards, flags complex products, and returns a timestamped, hashed suitability memo for the audit file. Price: $0.03.

allocation.description: Weights by asset class: equity, bonds, cash, alternatives, crypto... summing to 1.

client_ref.description: Your internal id; do not send names or account numbers.

liquidity_need_pct.description: Share of assets needed within 12 months.
